legend: Spindle cells arranged in fascicles surround areas of calcification containing epithelioid and chondroid cells and occasional multinucleated osteoclast-like giant cells.
A resection specimen showing an ill-defined greyish-white lesion with a gritty consistency.
The infiltrative spindle cell component is reminiscent of fibromatosis.

legend: Calcifying aponeurotic fibroma is characterized by bland spindle cells and nodular zones of calcification.

legend: Proliferation of spindled or epithelioid fibroblasts that tend to palisade around areas of calcification in a dense collagenous background.
